matching_numerical_convention: Ultralytics 8.3.63 validator; native confidence; ten matching thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95. Precision and recall use the evaluation-specific smoothed-F1 operating point at IoU 0.50.
reported_quantity: Native overall AP and operating-point precision/recall.

matching_numerical_convention: Descending confidence against the highest-IoU in-group annotation. Qualified duplicates are false positives without reassignment. If no in-group overlap qualifies, a qualified out-of-group overlap causes the prediction to be ignored; otherwise it is a false positive, including on background images.
reported_quantity: Group AP averages interpolated precision at 101 recall points; recall uses in-group annotations.

matching_numerical_convention: Float64 coordinates; IoU denominator constant 10^-9; eligibility IoU>=-10^-8. Matching flags are fixed across scoring conditions.
reported_quantity: Stable descending-score order; trapezoidal integration of the 101-point interpolated precision envelope, averaged over ten thresholds.

matching_numerical_convention: Float32 scores in descending order; ties by ascending candidate identity; hard suppression when IoU >0.50. Original candidates or original survivors are removed before replay.
reported_quantity: Re-entering and exiting prediction identities relative to reference NMS.

matching_numerical_convention: Float32 IoU; denominator constant 10^-7; eligibility IoU>=. Matching is reconstructed independently after each intervention and at each threshold.
reported_quantity: Annotation identities determine gained, lost, and reassigned matches. Counts are not AP contributions.
